image.alt: A small square steatite seal of the Sindhu-Sarasvati civilisation, showing a bull in profile with a vessel below its head and a row of five pictographic signs along the top edge.

signs.alt: Enlarged detail of the top edge of the same seal, showing just the five carved pictographic signs in a single row.

brahmi.alt: A weathered sandstone railing crossbar from the stupa at Sanchi, carved with one crisp horizontal line of Brahmi characters.

cuneiform.alt: A rectangular baked clay tablet from Mesopotamia, its surface covered in dense rows of wedge-shaped cuneiform characters pressed in with a reed stylus.

bilingual.alt: A dark inscribed stone slab carrying the same passage of text three times over, in three visibly different scripts stacked in three horizontal bands.
